remarks: Welcome to this private tri-level oasis tucked away on one of Santa Monica Canyon's most serene and coveted streets. Perched on a knoll and surrounded by mature trees and lush landscaping, this charming villa-style residence offers 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and approximately 1,950 square feet of thoughtfully refreshed living space. Ideally located at the beginning of West Rustic Road, the home feels worlds away from the city while remaining just moments from the beach and the beloved restaurants and shops along West Channel Road.
